title: Chapter 353
text:
The prerequisite for the Sunil NCO Class armor had been met, and Han Xiao could derive the blueprint from the armor. He did not want to sell it to the players for the time being. After all, he had just sold the Enlistee Class armor, and selling the NCO Class armor immediately would affect the benefits of strengthening the Enlistee Class armor.

I now have five class advancement knowledges, which can be combined into many new blueprints. My own equipment can be upgraded … Han Xiao stroked his chin and thought. He currently had four combat modes: the core system, Amphiptere mechanical suit; the close-range Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades + Thermo-Electrical Incisor Gauntlet; the mid-range Sonic Sphere; and the long-range Wrath of Garrett and Sniper Kiting. These four modes formed the foundation of a comprehensive combat system.

[Heavy Machinery Modification] gave him the technology to build large machinery, and [Advanced Electromagnetism] allowed him to build stable electromagnetic weapons. Electromagnetic weapons were the next level of conventional weapons, and they were higher than gunpowder weapons. These two knowledges were very useful, and he needed to upgrade them sooner or later. He spent sixteen Potential Points to upgrade them to the max level of v5.

If he wanted to upgrade his combat mode, his close-range weapons were no longer able to keep up with the times, so he could use this opportunity to create something new that was thick and big. For the mid-range and long-range weapons, he just needed to change his gunpowder weapons to electromagnetic weapons. His Ghost sniper rifle had always been an incomplete version, and it only lacked Advanced Electromagnetism. Now, it could be perfected.

The Amphiptere mechanical suit itself could not be completely revolutionized yet, so he only needed to strengthen it a little. If he wanted to add more functions, creating new accessories would be a good choice. Han Xiao had a vague idea of what to do. He rubbed his palms together and prepared to go all out.

Not only was his combat mode updated, but he also had the ability to build large machinery this time. Han Xiao was ready to build a large surface vehicle to be the transportation tool for the whole team. As soon as this idea popped up in his mind, two words immediately popped up in his mind.

Reliable!

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. A mobile vehicle can be the symbol of a mercenary group, and it can also show the expansion of the team and increase the interest of the members. Plus, with the addition of Advanced Electromagnetism, won't I be able to build a crude Electromagnetic Rail Cannon? A vehicle is the best carrier! "

He immediately got to work. He bought enough parts and materials, shut himself in the modification room, and told the players to rest for a while in the hub.

No one had any objections. This time, unlike when they had just entered the galaxy, the players had already tasted the sweetness of obeying orders. Even Li Ge did not have any other thoughts. Walking around the Hub Hall every day, interacting with different races and understanding more civilizations was a very interesting experience. Although professional players were very utilitarian, there were also many like Maple Moon who liked the story. The sea of stars was very attractive to them.

Taking advantage of the break, Pork Bun produced the second episode of the Black Star story. It was still edited like a movie, just like a TV series. Not only Blue Star, but also the players from all over the galaxy had been looking forward to it. More than a hundred thousand people watched it as soon as it was released.

The content of the show continued from the previous episode. The Black Star Mercenary's first mercenary mission, the history of the Sunil race and the Catastrophe. The majority of players who could not enter the galaxy were very interested in this. The mercenary group was the core of this show and also the eyes of countless viewers. The viewers slowly understood the galaxy through the mercenary group's experience, so they were very close to the mercenary group.

The show continued until the end of the Catastrophe. The mercenary group had a new partner, Herlous. It was like a new character appearing in a TV series, and it immediately attracted the attention of the players. Pork Bun released the new products of the faction store at the right time. The narration explained that factions could grow, which made the viewers look forward to the mercenary group's future adventures even more. At the same time, they were very envious of the players who followed Han Xiao.

Han Xiao also watched the show and was very satisfied with how Bun-Hit-Dog had handled it. As expected of someone he had taken a liking to, such a show could gradually develop the audience's habits and slowly develop feelings for him. The effect was good.

…

In a combat simulation room in the Hub Hall, Herlous waved the Battleship Slicing Blade and slashed the simulated beasts one after another. He had not fought for too long, so he came to the combat simulation room every day to get used to it. Because Han Xiao was immersed in manufacturing, he did not update the mercenary information. Therefore, in Herlous' heart, he was still the only Grade B Super in the team. He felt a heavy responsibility and trained hard.

After fighting for a few hours, all the illusions disappeared. The battlefield filled with corpses turned back into an empty white room. Herlous folded the Battleship Slicing Blade, wiped his sweat, and walked out of the room. At this time, Mad Blade, Hao Tian, and King Admiral walked out of the gravity room at the side. When they saw Herlous, they immediately approached him.

"You guys are training too." Herlous nodded at the team members. The players had been very friendly to him these days, and he felt that he was getting along well with the team. Herlous was not surprised by the players' names. Every civilization had their own way of naming, and he thought that it was the custom of Planet Han Xiao.

He could only wonder why the players could not die. The players naturally could not tell the truth, so Herlous thought that it was a collective Esper Ability.

"Can you teach us some combat techniques?" Hao Tian asked.

In the eyes of the players, Herlous was a treasure that had not been opened yet. They could try to trigger events and learn skills. Herlous did not teach them any skills. At most, he would teach them some melee combat techniques. With his guidance, the players' melee combat skills would increase by quite a lot. Triggering the guidance event required luck — it mainly depended on Herlous' mood. However, the benefits were free, so players would ask about it from time to time.

Since they were in the same team, Herlous did not mind. At this time, the regional news broadcast on a tall building beside them suddenly sounded an emergency alert.

"… Breaking news. A civilian Silvers traveling team was attacked by mysterious scavengers when they passed by the Shattered Star Ring. A group of Silvers was captured by slave traders. According to reports, the location of the attack is Colton Star Cluster — Fawn Star System — Star Zone Four. The scavengers' organization is unknown. The escaped Silvers have issued a high bounty, recruiting mercenaries to save their own race …"

This news attracted Herlous' attention. Silvers? This race came from the distant Sea of Star Spirits. They were a race at the level of Universe Nobles!

Some races with powerful civilizations and high evolution were called Universe Nobles. For example, the ruling races of the three Universal Civilizations were proper Universe Nobles. The Silvers did not reach the height of the three Universal Civilizations, but they were an advanced civilization that had existed for a long time and enjoyed a special status in the universe. Similarly, noble races were very popular in the slave market. They were fat prey in the eyes of the scavengers.

The Silvers were very rich, so the bounty they issued would definitely be astronomical. Herlous, who was lacking money, was tempted. With such a good opportunity to earn money, he had to persuade Black Star to take part in it no matter what.

Godora's jurisdiction was the Garton Star System. The Fawn Star System was close to the Garton Star System and was not as big as the Garton Star System. A few Star System civilizations that were slightly weaker than Godora controlled different Star Zones. Although they had defined their territories, there were often territorial disputes at the borders. It was not to the extent of war, but it still caused chaos.
